what: Buch 2023 Fig. 5h (protein translation gene sets): the descriptor grid registered exactly as the published figure shows it (claims register v4 section 2.7; section 6 item 5, operator approval 2026-09-26: re-read of an already-seen figure). Structure, printed cell labels and marks only; no statistic beyond what the figure prints; MOESM3 and every supplement unopened.
read_by: asdg-worker (A1 pre-freeze work), visual read of the figure image; transcription, not computed

source.paper: Buch et al. 2023, Nature Neuroscience, doi 10.1038/s41593-023-01259-x (citations key buch2023asdsubgroups)
source.image_kept: no (scratchpad only, not in git or E:)

encoding_as_printed.mark_key: a solid black cell border = 'Significant enrichment' (figure key)
encoding_as_printed.legend_sentence: Color indicates strength of negative log-transformed FDR for normalized enrichment score multiplied by the sign of the gene weight (+1 or -1).

columns_meaning: subgroups 1-4 (column header numbers under the panel title, as in Fig. 5c-g)

marked_cells.where: all five rows in subgroup 1; no cell of subgroups 2-4 marked

agreement_with_tsv.claims: the 5 marked cells = TSV rows 326-330 (BUCH-E-Trans-*-S1, cell_class claim); printed values equal the draft's (2.80, 2.25, 2.42, 2.94, 1.43)
agreement_with_tsv.descriptors: the 15 unmarked cells = TSV rows 422-436 (cell_class descriptor); the TSV records their published value as 'ns'; the figure prints 0 / 0.22 / 0 (row 1), 0 / 0.24 / 0 (row 2), 0 / 0.26 / 0 (row 3), 0 / 0.61 / 0.33 (row 4), 0.01 / 0.23 / 0.04 (row 5) for subgroups 2 / 3 / 4
agreement_with_tsv.direction: every printed value >= 0 (positive = enrichment among positively weighted genes, the figure's encoding)

open_points: The first row is printed '*Ribosomal structure' with an asterisk that neither the figure legend nor panel h explains; the draft and TSV read it as the GO-slim term 'structural constituent of ribosome' (GO:0003735). Other panels of Fig. 5 were not re-read (outside the approved re-read), so whether a footnote elsewhere on the figure defines the asterisk is not known here.

Row labels other than row 1 are printed as GO-style names ('Ribosomal subunit', 'Ribosome', 'Cytosolic ribosome', 'Cytoplasmic translation'); their exact PANTHER 16.0 GO-slim terms are fixed by the S-build, not by this read.
